# `m.crypto.quotes`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Quotes of crypto pairs: each exchange's best bid and ask, as they change.

```python
m.crypto.quotes(symbols)
```

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Quotes (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From WebSocket `pair`: "The crypto pair." | WebSocket |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the UTC date of `Timestamp`. | WebSocket |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. From WebSocket `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." | WebSocket |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | WebSocket |
| `BidPrice` | double | The bid price. | WebSocket |
| `BidSize` | double | The bid size. | WebSocket |
| `AskPrice` | double | The ask price. | WebSocket |
| `AskSize` | double | The ask size. | WebSocket |
| `Exchange` | long | The crypto exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/exchanges) for a list of exchanges and their IDs. | WebSocket |
| `ReceivedTimestamp` | Instant | The timestamp that the tick was received by Massive. | WebSocket |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | WebSocket |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (in code or in the settings file, as `unreadable_symbols: raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
